dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Last question, Nam. Is social media good or bad for young people?
dialogue.reading: ˈlæst ˈkwɛstʃən, ˈnɑːm. ɪz ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ˈɡʊd ɔːr ˈbæd fər ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Basically, it's useful, but it can take too much of your time.
dialogue.reading: ˈbeɪsɪkli, ɪts ˈjuːsfəl, bʌt ɪt kən ˈteɪk ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ əv jʊr ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you think you use it too much?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk juː ˈjuːz ɪt ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not any more, actually. I deleted two apps last month.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɛni ˈmɔːr, ˈæktʃuəli. aɪ dɪˈliːtɪd ˈtuː ˈæps ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. I missed the funny videos, but I sleep better now.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. aɪ ˈmɪst ðə ˈfʌni ˈvɪdioʊz, bʌt aɪ ˈsliːp ˈbɛtər ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's great to hear. Anyway, thank you for your time today.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt tə ˈhɪr. ˈɛniweɪ, ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˈtaɪm təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're welcome. By the way, can I read your report when it's finished?
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈwɛlkəm. baɪ ðə ˈweɪ, kən aɪ ˈriːd jʊr rɪˈpɔːrt wɛn ɪts ˈfɪnɪʃt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll email it to you next month.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪl ˈiːmeɪl ɪt tə juː ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ.
